verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM supports full local/on-device operation and self-hosting on your own infrastructure (docs-1, docs-2, docs-4, docs-8), which effectively lets users choose where data resides by deploying it in any region or on-prem themselves. However, there is no explicit hosted-service data-residency/region-selection feature (e.g., picking an EU vs US data center for the hosted plan) — control is achieved only indirectly via self-hosting. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency options for the hosted offering, compliance certifications (SOC2/GDPR data-location guarantees), and independent verification of self-hosted deployments in specific regions.
